title: Assisted Dip
summary: A dip on a counterweight machine for chest and triceps, building toward bodyweight dips.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: commercial gym machine (this exercise's own machine).

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for chest (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly chest total.
Library rating 0.9 for triceps (main mover): each working set adds 0.9 of a set to the weekly triceps total.
Library rating 0.5 for front delts (helper): each working set adds 0.5 of a set to the weekly front delts total.

setup.text: Set the assistance, kneel on the pad and grip the bars.
Lower until your shoulders are slightly below your elbows.
Press back up to straight arms.

form_cues.cue: Lower until shoulders are just below elbows
Go only as deep as your shoulders feel good.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only
alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less stable, More technical.
